title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 xXE attack was possible via an XML response to an HTTP Client…
description: JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4 are vulnerable to an XML External Entity (XXE) attack via an XML response to an HTTP Client request. This vulnerability allows an attacker to potentially exploit XML parsing to access unauthorized data. The CVSS score is low, indicating limited impact, primarily confidentiality loss without integrity or availability impact.
